title: The pinned VSIX is the DataPass that runs
as: A person who has just installed the release candidate
goal: Check that the isolated VS Code runs exactly the pinned DataPass build and that nothing signs in on its own.
hints: Extensions view: Ctrl+Shift+X, then look for DataPass Control Plane under Installed.
Wait two minutes with the window visible before judging the sign-in expectation.
expected: The Extensions view lists DataPass Control Plane at exactly the version recorded in run.json (datapass.version), and no second copy of DataPass.
No sign-in window or browser page (Azure, Microsoft, GitHub) opens by itself.
The DataPass activity bar icon is present and its Project view opens.
outOfScope: Installing over an older DataPass (the AI qualification covers the upgrade)
